verses.text: Moses was taking care of the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the flock to the far side of the desert and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in flames of fire from the middle of a bush. Moses looked and saw that the bush was on fire, but it did not burn up.
So Moses thought, "I will go over and look at this amazing sight. Why does the bush not burn up?"
When the LORD saw that Moses had come over to look, God called to him from the middle of the bush, "Moses! Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."
God said, "Do not come any closer. Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy ground."
Then he said, "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." Moses hid his face, because he was afraid to look at God.
The LORD said, "I have seen how my people in Egypt are suffering. I have heard them cry out because of their slave masters, and I know their pain.

So I have come down to save them from the Egyptians and to bring them out of that land into a good and wide land, a land flowing with milk and honey. It is the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
The cry of the people of Israel has reached me, and I have seen how cruelly the Egyptians are treating them.
So now go. I am sending you to Pharaoh, to bring my people, the people of Israel, out of Egypt."
But Moses said to God, "Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the people of Israel out of Egypt?"
God said, "I will be with you. And this will be the sign that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will all worship God on this mountain."
Moses said to God, "Suppose I go to the people of Israel and say to them, 'The God of your ancestors has sent me to you,' and they ask me, 'What is his name?' What should I tell them?"
God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM. This is what you must say to the people of Israel: 'I AM has sent me to you.'"

God also said to Moses, "Say this to the people of Israel: 'The LORD, the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.' This is my name forever. This is the name people will remember me by for all time.

Go and gather the leaders of Israel together and tell them, 'The LORD, the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, appeared to me. He said: I have been watching over you, and I have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
And I have promised to bring you up out of your suffering in Egypt into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, a land flowing with milk and honey.'

The leaders of Israel will listen to you. Then you and the leaders must go to the king of Egypt and say to him, 'The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Please let us go on a three-day journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God.'
But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless a mighty hand forces him.
So I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all the amazing things I will do there. After that, he will let you go.
And I will make the Egyptians kind to my people, so that when you leave, you will not go empty-handed.

Every woman will ask her neighbour, and any woman living in her house, for things made of silver and gold, and for clothes. You will put them on your sons and daughters. And so you will take away the riches of the Egyptians."
